usage: sot-validator digest [-h] [--previous-results PREVIOUS_RESULTS]
                            [--current-results CURRENT_RESULTS]
                            [--previous-quality PREVIOUS_QUALITY]
                            [--current-quality CURRENT_QUALITY] [--previous-certs PREVIOUS_CERTS]
                            [--current-certs CURRENT_CERTS] [--previous-fleet PREVIOUS_FLEET]
                            [--current-fleet CURRENT_FLEET] [--previous-drift PREVIOUS_DRIFT]
                            [--current-drift CURRENT_DRIFT] [--top-n TOP_N]
                            [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--send] [--dry-run]
                            [--policy {on_change,always}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --previous-results PREVIOUS_RESULTS
                        Previous run: validation_results.json (stale records).
  --current-results CURRENT_RESULTS
                        Current run: validation_results.json (stale records).
  --previous-quality PREVIOUS_QUALITY
                        Previous run: JSON written by `quality --output-json` (data-quality
                        errors).
  --current-quality CURRENT_QUALITY
                        Current run: JSON written by `quality --output-json` (data-quality
                        errors).
  --previous-certs PREVIOUS_CERTS
                        Previous run: JSON written by `cert-report --output-json` (certificates).
  --current-certs CURRENT_CERTS
                        Current run: JSON written by `cert-report --output-json` (certificates).
  --previous-fleet PREVIOUS_FLEET
                        Previous run: fleet-summary.json (site health drops).
  --current-fleet CURRENT_FLEET
                        Current run: fleet-summary.json (site health drops).
  --previous-drift PREVIOUS_DRIFT
                        Previous run: JSON written by `diff-scans --output-json` (discovery
                        drift).
  --current-drift CURRENT_DRIFT
                        Current run: JSON written by `diff-scans --output-json` (discovery drift).
  --top-n TOP_N         New items listed per category (default: 10).
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Also write digest.txt, digest.md, digest.html and digest.json here
                        (created if missing).
  --send                Deliver to the [digest.smtp] / [[digest.webhooks]] targets of the global
                        --config.
  --dry-run             With --send: print the targets, policy decision and message; read no
                        secret, open no socket.
  --policy {on_change,always}
                        Send policy for --send (default: [digest] policy, else on_change).
